name: SafeText AI — Cyberbullying Detection System
description: An AI-powered system that detects cyberbullying and toxic content in text, compares predictions across multiple models, and provides real-time classification with confidence scores through an interactive application.

name: AI Contract Intelligence System
description: An AI-powered system for analyzing legal contracts, detecting potentially risky clauses, and generating clearer, fairer alternatives. It combines automated clause analysis with context-aware retrieval to assist users in reviewing and improving contract languag.
